notablePrerequisites: Whisperer of the Wilds does not have summoning sickness. You control a creature with power 4 or greater who has at least a +3/+3 boost from secondary effects.
description:
Activate Whisperer of the Wilds by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Cast Wirewood Symbiote by paying {G}.
Activate Mirror Entity by paying {1}, giving creatures you control all creature types and base power and toughness 1/1 until end of turn.
Activate Wirewood Symbiote by returning it from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Whisperer of the Wilds.
Repeat.
